answer: Attestation as a bonded orchard: each identity stakes and must keep producing signed, machine-unique inference work peers can replay. A sybil farm needs one real runner per tree and pays its power; trees sharing a funding root are grafted into one and counted once. Each epoch a jury samples fruit (answers); a tree whose fruit fails grading is cut and its stake burned. The honest signal is reproducible work, not self-reported identity: N seats cost N machines, and each extra seat gets dearer as audits tighten. A vertex-level check on who attested whom, from which wallet, closes the loop.
